parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id              AS lead_id,
  l.email,
  l.first_name,
  l.last_name,
  l.full_name,
  l.title,
  l.company,
  l.phone,
  l.linkedin_url,
  l.icp_tier        AS tier,
  l.score,
  l.status,
  l.stage,
  l.score_breakdown,
  l.client_id,
  l.sequence_id,
  c.name            AS company_name,
  c.website,
  c.industry,
  c.employee_count,
  c.annual_revenue,
  c.country,
  cc.config         AS client_config,
  cm.hubspot_contact_id,
  cm.hubspot_deal_id,
  cm.salesforce_contact_id,
  cm.salesforce_opportunity_id
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN companies    c  ON c.id  = l.company_id
LEFT JOIN client_configs cc ON cc.client_id = l.client_id
LEFT JOIN crm_mappings cm ON cm.lead_id = l.id
WHERE l.id = $1
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO crm_mappings (
  lead_id, crm_provider,
  hubspot_contact_id, hubspot_deal_id,
  last_synced_at, created_at
) VALUES (
  $1, 'hubspot', $2, $3, NOW(), NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (lead_id, crm_provider)
DO UPDATE SET
  hubspot_contact_id = EXCLUDED.hubspot_contact_id,
  hubspot_deal_id    = EXCLUDED.hubspot_deal_id,
  last_synced_at     = NOW();

INSERT INTO crm_mappings (
  lead_id, crm_provider,
  salesforce_contact_id, salesforce_opportunity_id,
  last_synced_at, created_at
) VALUES (
  $1, 'salesforce', $2, $3, NOW(), NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (lead_id, crm_provider)
DO UPDATE SET
  salesforce_contact_id     = EXCLUDED.salesforce_contact_id,
  salesforce_opportunity_id = EXCLUDED.salesforce_opportunity_id,
  last_synced_at            = NOW();

INSERT INTO sales_metrics (
  client_id, lead_id, event_type,
  industry, seniority, tier,
  sequence_step, variant_group,
  created_at
) VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3,
  $4, $5, $6,
  $7, $8,
  NOW()
);

INSERT INTO activities (type, lead_id, payload, created_at)
VALUES ('crm_synced', $1, $2::jsonb, NOW());

INSERT INTO worker_events (worker_id, event_type, payload, created_at)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1),
  'crm.updated',
  $1::jsonb,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO lead_outcomes (
  lead_id, meeting_held, deal_value, deal_result,
  created_at
)
SELECT
  id, $2, $3, $4, NOW()
FROM leads
WHERE id = $1::uuid
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
